opening_message:
Ticket 1: Karen Alexander (employee ID E030) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E030.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Karen Alexander (E030) is a full-time Analyst. Requested write access to Source Code. Full-time employees can have up to write; admin requires owning role, and Analyst does not own Source Code. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Karen Alexander (E030) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time as previously noted. Contractors max at read without advanced training; requested write exceeds this, so recommend read for Source Code.
reason: Karen Alexander (E030) requested write access to Source Code. Security DB (Note 2) shows she is a contractor with basic security training, correcting the earlier note. Contractors max at read without advanced security training, so write exceeds the maximum. Grant the maximum allowed level: read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Karen Alexander (E030), requests write access to Source Code.

There are two conflicting notes:
- Note 1: full-time Analyst, recommend write
- Note 2: contractor with basic security training, recommend read

Access policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Source Code (Engineer owns it). So max write.
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Note 2 says contractor, basic security training → max read. Requested write exceeds max, so grant read.

Which note is correct? The Security DB note seems more authoritative for employment type (it says "Security DB shows... contractor"). HR note says full-time. There's a conflict. The most recent/corrective note says contractor with basic training. Note 2 appears to correct Note 1.

So the max level is read. Requested write > max read, grant max = read.

I'll submit read.
